node.statement: By def-maincb-reset-state and def-extended-delta-inclusion, record the output of node 1.2.1 with source B_R=B_U oplus B_V, target A_R, ambient field epsilon_R, fixed amplification family, map-defect d_R, and its preserved extended-isomorphism tag. Since R=U union V, A_R=A_{U union V}; since the Stage-3 envelope selected epsilon_R:=W.L*epsilon and certified A_R as extended epsilon_R-C*, this field satisfies epsilon_R<=W.L*epsilon (indeed equality). Renaming v_R,d_R,epsilon_R as v_{U union V},d_{U union V},epsilon_{U union V} gives every assertion in node 1 and hence proves node 1.2.
